authoringSummary.freshnessCaveat: Roster identity was frozen from the latest completed official LEC series before 2026-08-23. Ratings use evidence through 2026-08-22; 2026-08-23 matches were excluded. Current-event indexing gaps and absence of recent champion play were never treated as negative evidence.
